watches.name: 22mm & 20mm, Stainless Steel Bracelets in brushed steel with quick release pins
watches.description: Golby Watch Straps Ltd Presents: 22mm & 20mm, Stainless Steel Bracelets in brushed steel with quick release pins Fitting Width – 22mm & 20mm Strap Colour – brushed steel Strap – This is a stainless steel strap (304L) that comes with straight end links with quick release pins. As a free bonus we also include a curved end link cover with standard spring bars. (Please note the curved end will not fit all watches as each watch varies depending on the watch curve, lug length and spring bar holes positioning) Clasp / Buckle Colour – Steel Clasp / Buckle – Made from 304 stainless steel Sizing – These bracelets come 20 cm long excluding your watch size. However we will re-size for free before shipping if you message us. Please review the sizing guide picture and specify how many links for each side of the clasp you would like removing within 2 hours of placing the order. All removed links will be shipped with the bracelet. Helpful videos are available on our face book page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/161428229335693/media/videos Variations – This strap is available in 22mm & 20mm sizes, fully brushed steel and brushed and polished. Each order Contains. • Watch strap and clasp as listed. • Watch strap pins. (QR and standard) • Spring Bar removing fork tool • Bracelet link pin removing tool • Please note the watches pictured are not part of the sale. Warning • Please keep receipt so you can justify to your other half its just a new strap and not a new watch!
